evidence.title: Content-Based Table Retrieval for Web Queries
evidence.text: 7 Conclusion In this paper, we give an empirical study of content-based table retrieval for web queries. We implement a feature-based approach and a neural network based approach, and release a new dataset consisting of web queries and web tables.

evidence.title: Content-Based Table Retrieval for Web Queries
evidence.text: In the candidate table retrieval phase, we encode a table as bag-of-words to guarantee the efﬁciency of the approach. Speciﬁcally, on WebQueryTable dataset we represent a table with caption and head- ers. On WikiTableQuestions dataset we represent a table with caption, headers and cells.
